name: v1.8.17
body:
## What's Changed
* Prepare staging workload identities for usage jobs by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1911
* Preview candidate production settings from main by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1913
* Promote registry v1.8.16 to production by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1912
* Switch staging usage jobs to their GKE identities by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1914
* Retire the shared staging usage credential by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1915
* Prepare production workload identities for usage jobs by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1916
* Switch production usage jobs to their GKE identities by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1917
* Verify the reviewed production jobs before retiring the shared usage key by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1919
* Retire the shared production usage credential by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1918
* fix(validators): reject loopback/private/link-local hosts in IsValidRemoteURL by @amitvijapur in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1470
* build(deps): bump github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3 from 3.276.0 to 3.277.0 in /deploy in the deploy-go-dependencies group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1922
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-go from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1923

## New Contributors
* @amitvijapur made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1470

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/compare/v1.8.16...v1.8.17

name: v1.8.13
body:
## What's Changed
* Promote registry v1.8.12 to production and switch on the malware sweep by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1891
* Describe the malware sweep as it now runs in production by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1892
* Start every malware alert's email subject with the cluster's name by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1894
* Fix and tidy the three operational Grafana dashboards by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1893
* Report entries whose package is gone, and end each sweep with one report by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1895


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/compare/v1.8.12...v1.8.13
